tasks.label: MediSimple: 1 Env check
tasks.command: node --version; npm --version; supabase --version; vercel --version; ls .env 2>/dev/null && echo DOTENV_PRESENT || echo DOTENV_MISSING; grep -q '^ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant' .env 2>/dev/null && echo ANTHROPIC_KEY_PRESENT || echo ANTHROPIC_KEY_MISSING; echo TASK_DONE_MARKER

tasks.label: MediSimple: 3 Run tests
tasks.command: npx vitest run 2>&1 | tee /tmp/ms-3-test.log; echo TASK_DONE_MARKER >> /tmp/ms-3-test.log

tasks.label: MediSimple: 4 Build
tasks.command: npm run build 2>&1 | tee /tmp/ms-4-build.log; echo TASK_DONE_MARKER >> /tmp/ms-4-build.log

tasks.label: MediSimple: 5 Supabase db push
tasks.command: supabase db push 2>&1 | tee /tmp/ms-5-push.log; echo TASK_DONE_MARKER >> /tmp/ms-5-push.log

tasks.label: MediSimple: 6 Deploy edge functions
tasks.command: supabase functions deploy summarize 2>&1 | tee /tmp/ms-6-func.log; supabase functions deploy consult 2>&1 | tee -a /tmp/ms-6-func.log; echo TASK_DONE_MARKER >> /tmp/ms-6-func.log

tasks.label: MediSimple: 7 Set Anthropic secret
tasks.command: supabase secrets set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=$(grep '^ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=' .env | cut -d= -f2-) > /tmp/ms-7-secret.log 2>&1; echo "exit=$?" >> /tmp/ms-7-secret.log; echo TASK_DONE_MARKER >> /tmp/ms-7-secret.log
